_comment: Shared OCR pipe-repair cases, read by internal/ocr (repairPipeMisreads) and extension/src/ocr-text.js (repairPipeMisreads). This is the token mechanic only: every bare | token of a gated line becomes I. The guards that spare a bar - the outline the outlier trim handles, a table's column grid - live in the cluster flush, where the word boxes are (OCR-PIPELINE amendment 1.5). See docs/PARITY.md, Pipe misread repair.

cases.about: the field repro of 2026-09-28: a sentence-initial I read as a pipe

cases.line: watch TV very seldom, because | have many
cases.want: watch TV very seldom, because I have many

cases.line: Sometime go for shopping, water the flowers. |
cases.want: Sometime go for shopping, water the flowers. I
cases.about: trailing I at the line's end, misread at the wrap
the I that follows the wrap carries the sentence's subject

cases.line: dress. | make a bed. My friend come to me at
cases.want: dress. I make a bed. My friend come to me at
cases.about: one pipe inside an otherwise ordinary line
a bare pipe alone; a cluster of such lines never reaches the repair, the gate refuses it raw
the mechanic repairs every bare pipe; a real table's bars are spared by the column guard in the flush, where the word boxes are
a pipe welded to letters is a different misread with a different answer
